name: Web search
description: Search the web with DuckDuckGo and read the results. No account or key needed.

name: Web page reader
description: Download any web page and read it as clean text, including long pages in chunks.

description: Web, news, image and local search through Brave's search API. Needs a Brave API key (about 1,000 free searches a month).

name: Wikipedia
description: Search Wikipedia and read articles, summaries and sections.

name: Document reader
description: Read PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and other documents by turning them into text. By Microsoft.

name: YouTube transcripts
description: Get the transcript and details of any YouTube video so I can summarize or quote it.

name: Obsidian vault
description: Search, read, create and edit notes in your Obsidian vault, working directly on the files.

name: Time and time zones
description: The exact current time, and converting times between time zones.

name: Calculator
description: Work out math exactly instead of guessing.

name: Weather
description: Current weather, forecasts and air quality anywhere, from Open-Meteo. No key needed.

name: Step-by-step thinking
description: A scratchpad for planning and working through complicated problems one step at a time.

name: GitHub
description: Browse repos and code, manage issues and pull requests, and check Actions runs, through GitHub's official server.

name: SQLite database
description: Open a local SQLite database, explore its tables and run queries.

name: Library docs
description: Up-to-date documentation and code examples for thousands of programming libraries.
